name: Juggle Gauge and Combo Time
summary: Read how long an air combo can continue.
description: Read how long an air combo can continue.

pages.title: The Juggle Gauge
pages.text: The {tone:juggle|cyan Juggle Gauge} under a launched opponent shows how long they remain unable to recover. Power usually gives the next hit more time, but the previous move, height, and character also matter.

pages.title: Running Low
pages.text: At {tone:juggle_yellow|20 visual frames or less}, the gauge turns yellow. Stored Guard Gauge can hold this countdown; the Defense section shows that interaction.

pages.title: Almost Empty
pages.text: At {tone:juggle_red|10 visual frames or less}, the gauge turns red. When it empties, ordinary juggle hits stop connecting and air recovery becomes available.

tasks.label: Hit the jumping Misaki and make the gauge appear
tasks.prompt: Misaki will keep jumping toward you. Hit her out of the air - {input:j.A} works - and look for the gauge that appears beneath her.

feedback.success: The gauge is running - that is her remaining juggle time.

tasks.label: Let the gauge empty and watch the recovery
tasks.prompt: Now hold your attacks. Watch the gauge drain to nothing and watch Misaki become free to act again.

feedback.success: The gauge emptied - past that point ordinary juggle hits stop working.
feedback.failure: Do not attack during the countdown. If Misaki lands first, hit the next jump higher so the gauge can empty in the air.

cue.text: Misaki's jumping in - hit her airborne!
